authorization: User authorised bounded follow-on experiments intended to improve CV performance.
input_prompt: the top support beam of a wooden utility pole.
rule_origin: Fixed after the UK-development v1 morphology failure audit: reject non-upright pole inputs and candidate boxes that extend too far down a pole shaft. This is a development guardrail, not an independent UK evaluation.

epri_check.dataset: EPRI circuit 4 publisher truth already embedded in the pinned input records
epri_check.purpose: Measure the precision/recall cost of the fixed guardrail; no rule selection.

uk_development.purpose: Apply the fixed guardrail to pinned raw model outputs; proposal audit only, no accuracy.

budget: One deterministic post-processing pass over pinned records. No model inference, training, UK v3 access, threshold sweep or automatic retry.
claim_boundary: The guardrail can remove morphologically invalid proposals but cannot establish UK accuracy or recall. Scores remain raw uncalibrated Grounding DINO values.
